description: This PHP source file defines a class 'gitlab' which provides an API client for interacting with GitLab's REST API, including methods for managing issues, projects, and configuration settings.

classes.name: gitlab
classes.description: A class that wraps GitLab REST API interactions, providing methods for issues, projects, and configuration management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gitlab object with URL, API key, project ID, and optional configuration.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes cURL with specific settings including proxy, SSL, and user agent.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the web URL of an issue given its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches an issue object from GitLab by its ID.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Fetches list of issues for the configured project.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with a given title and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note (comment) to an existing issue.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves list of all projects accessible.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project by its identifier.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform HTTP GET request and parse JSON response.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and decodes the JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with given method, URL, and optional body, handling cURL options and errors.
